from bookings import load_bookings, ROWS
from summary import BookingSummary

MEAN = sum(v for _, v in ROWS) / len(ROWS)


def test_mean_of_stored():
    assert abs(BookingSummary(load_bookings()).mean_nights() - MEAN) < 1e-9


def test_count_of_list():
    assert BookingSummary(list(load_bookings())).count() == len(ROWS)
